headline: IT Security and Data Privacy Associate

skill_groups.label: Security
items: system security: access reviews and patching

skill_groups.label: Privacy and compliance
items: privacy notices, agreements and legal documentation

summary: IT security and data privacy associate with five years at a cooperative bank and an insurance agency in Negros and Siquijor. I run security awareness and access reviews, apply security policies and standards, and handle Data Privacy Act compliance, from privacy notices to breach procedures. My work sits between IT and legal.

experience.title: IT Security and Data Privacy Associate
bullets: Run quarterly access reviews and check that security patches are applied on all systems.
Apply the company's security policies and track gaps against ISO/IEC 27001 controls.
Maintain the privacy management program, privacy notices and data-sharing agreements.
Train staff yearly on phishing, passwords and handling personal data.

experience.title: IT Support and Security Assistant
bullets: Supported users and set up accounts and permissions following security policies.
Helped prepare the bank's data privacy registration and breach procedures.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
